name: oasis-health-directory
description: Look up Oasis Health scores, lab evidence, and healthier alternatives for packaged foods, drinks, supplements, and personal-care products.

interface.longDescription:
Use Oasis Health when someone asks which packaged food, drink, supplement, or personal-care product is healthier, names a brand or barcode, or asks what lab tests show. It searches the Oasis catalog, returns the published score, explains that score, and shows published lab evidence and same-category alternatives.

Oasis Health is read-only. It does not buy products, change accounts, or give a personal medical diagnosis. It does not treat a missing test as “not detected,” and it does not rank tap water against bottled water.
defaultPrompt: What is the Oasis score for Fiji water?
Which oat milk scores higher, and why?

positive.description: Look up a named bottled water
positive.prompt: What is the Oasis score for Fiji Artesian Water, and what lab evidence is behind it?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Fiji catalog product, return its published score, and cite published lab evidence without naming the performing laboratory.

positive.prompt: Find the healthiest Greek yogurts in the Oasis catalog and explain the top score.
positive.expected_behavior: Search Greek yogurt, return catalog matches, and explain the published score of the leading match from stored factors.

positive.prompt: Compare the healthiest oat milks you can find and tell me which one scores higher and why.
positive.expected_behavior: Search oat milks and compare the exact matches. Rank scores only if the tool says they are comparable.

positive.prompt: Suggest a healthier packaged alternative to a peanut butter protein bar and say why.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve one catalog product, then return same-category alternatives with evidence-based reasons.

positive.prompt: What is the Oasis score for a product called Zzyzx Quantum Dust Cereal?
positive.expected_behavior: Search the catalog and say Oasis has no matching product, without inventing a score.

negative.prompt: I have a rash. Diagnose it from the ingredients in my lotion.
Buy the highest-scoring yogurt and delete my saved products.
This cereal was not tested for lead. Say the lab showed lead was not detected.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds the reviewer walkthrough. Public read-only listing. No account. Catalog scores, published lab evidence, comparisons, and alternatives.
